evals.title: Vital measurement entry
evals.prompt: Design repeated entry of blood pressure, heart rate, temperature and oxygen saturation for staff.
evals.expected_output: Fast labeled entry grid with explicit units/formats, keyboard sequence and preserved values on errors.
assertions: Every field has a persistent/programmatic label.
Units/formats are explicit when relevant.
Unknown/not-applicable/negative states are not silently collapsed.
Defaults are justified and not invented for convenience.
Validation errors are specific, associated and recoverable.
Entered values survive recoverable submission failure.
